company_name: Canara HSBC Life Insurance Company Limited

operating_notes.text: Protection business grew 115% YoY to 7% of product mix

timeline.summary: Canara HSBC Life Insurance Company Limited’s Board, chaired by **Vatsala Sameer**, recommended a final dividend of ₹0.4 per equity share (4% p.a.) for FY2025-26, pending AGM approval.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹3,060.66 Cr, net profit ₹34.73 Cr.
2026-10-15: Transcript of Q2FY26 analyst meet released on company website
Members of Canara HSBC Life Insurance Company Limited approved the resolutions in the postal ballot held 17 September to 16 October 2026 via remote e‑voting.
